review_scope: Targeted static re-review of the two previously reported runner fixes only; no imports, API calls, execution, or model/prefix access.

prior_findings.issue: Mapped input files were verified, but prepare_inputs reopened fixed filenames in their common parent without proving those paths were the mapped files.
prior_findings.evidence: runner.py lines 279-288 now requires each verified path to equal prefix_dir / its fixed input name before calling prepare_inputs.

prior_findings.issue: Output setup and interpreter/environment checks ran outside the worker try block, so early failures could escape worker failure/state recording.
prior_findings.evidence: runner.py lines 165-188 initializes events to None and performs directory/log setup plus platform, environment, and Python checks inside try. Lines 439-459 preserve a nonzero failure result, attempt JSON records, print record-write failures to stderr for supervisor capture, and close events only when opened.

supplemental_check.evidence: After the one-thread checks, runner.py lines 252-253 rejects torch.version.cuda when non-null. Lines 254-261 record torch_build, torch_cuda_build, requested_device=cpu, gpu_devices_used=0, and environment_interactions=0 in environment.json.

conclusion: Both prior targeted fixes remain present. The supplemental CPU-build check and requested resource declarations are present. No other runner change was assessed.
